units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 28:56">Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 56</cite> ed. Berl. (Ms. I <cite ref="M03098"><he>מִתְפַּנְקוּ</he></cite>, some ed. <he>אתפנקו</he>, v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 58; Y. <cite ref="Q01893"><he>פרניקא</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Pesachim 50b:4">Pes. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>משום מ׳ הוא</he> it is merely because they are used to indulgence (idleness).
<cite ref="Chagigah 6a:4">Ḥag. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>חנה מ׳ יתירתא וכ׳</he> Hannah saw in Samuel extraordinary tenderness (saw that he was a very delicate child).
